title: Bell and Room
author: Orsen Coldharbour
blurb: Gideon Sandoval, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
